risks.quote: Ensure that AI systems do not perpetuate or amplify bias and discrimination.

responsibilities.quote: All AI projects require an AI Risk Assessment
Maintain human oversight; AI is an augmentation tool, not a replacement for professional judgment.
All staff and students working with AI must complete the University’s Ethical AI and Data Protection e-module.
Review annually as a minimum, or upon significant legislative, technological or organisational changes.
Report AI-related incidents to Legal Services and Data
